intersection.headline: Nike unveils Vaporfly 5, Mind models and Tuned Air ahead of its first investor day in nine years
intersection.summary: Nike revealed a wave of new products before CEO Elliott Hill's investor day, with most due in 2027. Hill is also expected to set out a new five-year financial model through fiscal 2031, a $2.5bn Pace savings plan, and fixes for China and Jordan. Highsnobiety called the weirder products, such as the Mind line and the inflatable Therma-Fit A.I.R. jacket, the standouts.

intersection.headline: Nike ends Adidas' 25-year Champions League ball reign with a reported €40m-a-year deal
intersection.summary: Nike becomes official match ball supplier for the Champions League from next season. It is the first brand to supply the ball for all three UEFA men's club competitions. The reported fee doubles the current deal's value and lands just after Mbappé chose On over Nike.

sports.headline: UEFA backs France's Philippe Diallo to challenge Gianni Infantino for the FIFA presidency
sports.summary: UEFA's executive committee unanimously backed French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo to stand against Infantino in the March 2027 FIFA election. UEFA has led opposition to Infantino since his plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors. The vote is due at the FIFA Congress in Rabat on 18 March 2027.

sports.headline: Mirra Andreeva, 19, wins the WTA Finals on her debut without dropping a set
sports.summary: Andreeva beat Elina Svitolina 7-5, 6-3 in the final at Indian Wells. She is the youngest champion since Maria Sharapova in 2004 and only the third teenager to win the title on debut. It ends her first Grand Slam-winning season at world number two.

sports.headline: USA beat Canada 6-2 to win the women's hockey world title, completing a historic Olympic and Worlds double
sports.summary: Hilary Knight scored twice as the US defended the Women's Worlds title, eight months after Olympic gold in Milan. It is the first time the US women have won Olympic and world gold in the same year. Taylor Fox also set a single-tournament record of 13 assists.

sports.headline: Thomas Frank returns to the Premier League as Crystal Palace head coach
sports.summary: Sky Sports News first reported that Palace had agreed terms in principle with Frank to replace the sacked Pierre Sage. The club then confirmed a contract to June 2029. Palace are bottom of the table, and Frank's first game is at Coventry on Saturday.

fashion.headline: Gucci to stage its next Cruise show in Shanghai on 17 May
fashion.summary: Kering's flagship brand will hold its Cruise show in the key China market as it works to re-ignite sales. The announcement comes months ahead of the event.

fashion.headline: Kanye West's Yeezy returns to the runway for the first time in four years
fashion.summary: Ye showed mostly monochrome Yeezy sportswear and statement accessories at a Los Angeles show attended by Bianca Censori, Big Sean and Kid Cudi. WWD reports mixed reviews and says consumers will decide the label's future.

fashion.headline: David Beckham's DB Ventures sues Coty for $41m over fragrances found in discount stores
fashion.summary: DB Ventures alleges its David Beckham-branded scents were sold at UK budget chain Poundland and a petrol station without approval. It is seeking $41 million in damages from its fragrance partner Coty.

fashion.headline: A.W.A.K.E. Mode founder Natalia Alaverdian steps down as creative director after the brand's sale
fashion.summary: Alaverdian is leaving the London label she founded in 2012, a year after selling her majority stake to Another Community. She will focus on filmmaking and other creative work.

marketing.headline: Ad Age's top 5 creative campaigns right now, from Netflix to Waitrose
marketing.summary: Weekly breakdown of standout campaigns, including Mother's cinematic Netflix work, a Disney spot and a Christmas-themed John C. Reilly ad. Useful analysis of current creative.

marketing.headline: Marketing Week podcast: unwrapping 2026's Christmas ads with Waitrose, Boots and Argos
marketing.summary: Marketers from the brands behind this year's festive campaigns discuss which will come out on top. It follows exclusive Ipsos data showing John Lewis as an early favourite.

marketing.headline: Zalando appoints Ray Cao to lead its retail media business, pitching shopping data to fashion brands
marketing.summary: The newly appointed senior VP spoke to WWD about opening Zalando's shopper data to brands such as Levi's and Adidas through self-service analytics and sponsored placements. It is a notable leadership move in fashion retail media.

marketing.headline: LEON appoints Romy Miller as chief marketing officer
marketing.summary: Miller joins from Knoops, where she was CMO for two years. She previously spent years at GAIL's, growing it to 80 bakeries. She will report to CEO John Vincent and work across restaurants, grocery and D2C.
